messages:
rachel: Heads-up  planned benchmark + blog publish tomorrow 09:00 PT. PR has embargoed distribution at 09:05. Need final sign-offs by EOD.

tom: Quick question  did we land on the phrasing for customer data handling in the benchmark appendix? compliance asked for a stronger statement.

zainab: Compliance flagged that the phrase "anonymized outputs" is ambiguous. suggested: "we do not retain customer inputs or outputs beyond transient processing unless explicitly enabled by the customer for evals or support."

compliance: Confirmed. Also request: add a short footnote about retention for A/B experiments.

lisa-design: Hero image v2 uploaded to assets - added annotation for caption. Preview link: <assets/release/hero-v2.png>. Alt text: "graph of latency vs cost with Redwood logo".

kevin-pr: PR notes  one European outlet asked to lift embargo early; they have a preprint. I'm recommending we keep them on embargo but offer an embargoed briefing instead. Thoughts?

tom: If we let them lift early we risk uneven pickup. I'd rather keep embargo intact and offer a briefing.

zainab: Agreed. Also ops reported a flakiness in the benchmark runner yesterday  did that get resolved? we don't want corrupted numbers.

ops-bot: Incident created: BENCH-2134. Failure during long-tail latency sampling at 03:14 UTC. Root cause under investigation.

rachel: Oh no  if BENCH-2134 impacts the data set we need to hold the publish until we rerun affected shards. How long is a rerun?

ops-bot: Estimated rerun time for affected shards: ~6 hours. We can parallelize but still need verification.

kevin-pr: Recommend pausing public distribution until we confirm numbers. We can still prep all other assets and ask press for a 24-hour hold.

lisa-design: I'll freeze creative and push updated assets to the CMS with the new compliance wording.

compliance: Approve the retention sentence: "We do not retain customer inputs or outputs beyond transient processing unless you opt in for evaluation or support." Please ensure it's in both blog and benchmark appendix.

rachel: Decision: hold publish. Move post + embargoed distribution by 24 hours to allow rerun and legal final sign-off. Kevin, can PR ask the embargo list for a 24h courtesy hold?

kevin-pr: On it  I'll send the courtesy hold to the full embargo list and flag the EU outlet for a follow-up briefing. Ticket PR-6012 opened.

ops-bot: BENCH-2134 status: rerun queued at 05:20 UTC, expected verification at 11:30 UTC.

tom: For transparency, we'll add a short note to the blog draft: "Update: publish delayed for data verification. We expect to publish on [new date/time]." Approve?

zainab: Approve. Keep it concise.

rachel: OK team. Action items: 1) PR hold email (kevin) 2) compliance wording into CMS (lisa) 3) rerun verification (ops) 4) draft delay note (tom). Post-mortem to follow in #marketing-postmortem.

kevin-pr: Sent hold to embargo list at 12:22 PT. Received acknowledgment from 8/12 outlets.

lisa-design: CMS updated with compliance copy and new hero at 12:30 PT.

ops-bot: BENCH-2134 rerun completed. Verification in progress.

rachel: Thanks. Keep me posted on verification result and we'll pick new publish time after confirmation. :handshake:
